assessment: Two unvalidated artifact/interface hypotheses. Observations suggest selection and orientation opportunities but establish neither error causes nor achievable savings. Both require cost, capacity and schedule checks before adoption.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: an order-specific board carrier replaces part of the worker contents check and customer layout interpretation. Each required partition occupies an outlined position; adjacent placement marks map it to the ordered arrangement.
openings.delta: Hybrid parents are a completeness stencil and an assembly map. Mixed-layout variation becomes a visible empty position, overlap or unmatched mark. A speculative carrier would encode every valid kit and arrangement automatically; dependencies are a verified layout-to-parts mapping and distinguishable part outlines. Test a manually traced partial capability first.
openings.prediction: The carrier reduces unnoticed missing/wrong parts and short-partition questions, particularly during mixed-layout work.
openings.probe: Use spare-board mockups for all three counts, counterbalance mixed-order packing against current practice, and deliberately seed omissions and substitutions. Record detection and separate selection/checking/packing times; compare unaided layout success with ten participants.
assumptions: Failure boundary: same-outline incompatible parts or an incorrect order map can pass; exterior color needs an explicit matching cue.
Carrier fits existing packaging; production cost stays within 0.40 per order and 500 initially, with delivery unchanged. Retain original functional components and reversible joints.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: a reversible compliant lead-in with a visible seating witness transfers alignment guidance into the partition/base interface.
openings.delta: Hybrid parents are an elastic guide and a displacement indicator: insertion resistance deflects the guide, exposing a misalignment cue before seating. A speculative self-correcting joint requires controlled board stiffness, safe elastic travel and load-bearing seating; a marked sacrificial guide tests the partial sensing capability.
openings.prediction: If misalignment contributes, visible guide deflection predicts repeat attempts and guidance reduces them; overlapping widths alone cannot establish this.
openings.probe: Compare current, witness-only and guide-plus-witness sample joints. Record attempts, force, cue accuracy and damage; repeatedly dismantle, rearrange and load successful samples with the specified assortment.
assumptions: Failure boundary: excessive force, moisture or fatigue defeats elastic guidance; misleading cues reject the design.
Preserve footprint, capacity, counts and exterior color. Tooling, recurring cost and implementation time must meet the fixed constraints.
